title: Neural Mobilisation — Testing and Treating the Nerve as a Moving Structure

hook.en: Nerves slide and stretch when you move. Learn to test that movement, tell a nerve problem from a muscle problem, and treat with sliders or tensioners safely.
hook.ur: Harkat par nerves sarakti aur khinchti hain. Is harkat ko test karna, nerve ke masle ko muscle ke masle se alag karna, aur sliders ya tensioners se mehfooz ilaaj karna seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll perform a neurodynamic test, use structural differentiation, and choose between a slider and a tensioner for an irritable or a settled nerve.
goal.ur: End tak aap neurodynamic test karenge, structural differentiation istemal karenge, aur irritable ya settled nerve ke liye slider aur tensioner mein se chunenge.

text.en: A nerve is not a rope fixed at both ends. It **slides** through its surroundings and **stretches** a little when the limb moves. When it becomes sensitive, for example after a disc injury or a tight tunnel, normal movement can reproduce arm or leg symptoms. **Neurodynamic tests** (the straight leg raise, the slump test and the upper limb neurodynamic tests) load the nerve on purpose to see whether it is the source.
text.ur: Nerve do sirron par bandhi rassi nahi. Yeh apne aas paas se **sarakti** hai aur limb ke hilne par thori si **khinchti** hai. Jab yeh sensitive ho jaye, maslan disc ki chot ya tang tunnel ke baad, to aam harkat bhi bazoo ya taang ki alamat dobara paida kar sakti hai. **Neurodynamic tests** (straight leg raise, slump test aur upper limb neurodynamic tests) nerve par jaan bujh kar bojh daalte hain taake dekha jaye ke kya yehi sabab hai.

text.en: Picture a nerve as a fishing line through a bendy straw. Bend the straw and the line moves along it; bend it too far in two places and the line pulls tight. A **slider** moves the line along without pulling it tight. A **tensioner** pulls it tight from both ends. If the line is already frayed, you start with the slider.
text.ur: Nerve ko mudne wale straw mein fishing line ki tarah sochein. Straw modein to line saath chalti hai; do jagah bohat modein to line tight ho jati hai. **Slider** line ko bina tight kiye chalata hai. **Tensioner** dono sirron se khinchta hai. Agar line pehle se ghisi hui ho to slider se shuru karein.

title.en: A neurodynamic test in four steps

steps.title: Position and add the movements one by one
steps.detail: For the straight leg raise: lie supine, then raise the straight leg. For the slump: sit, slump, flex the neck, extend the knee, dorsiflex the foot. Add each part slowly and record where the symptoms start. || Position aur harkatein ek ek karke jorein

steps.title: Look for the patient's own symptoms
steps.detail: A positive test reproduces the symptoms the patient complains of, such as pain, pins and needles or numbness, not just a pulling feeling in the hamstrings or the calf. || Patient ki apni alamat dhoondein

steps.title: Do structural differentiation
steps.detail: Change a movement far from the symptom, for example release the neck flexion or the ankle dorsiflexion. If the symptoms change, the nerve is involved; if they do not, think of a muscle or joint cause. || Structural differentiation karein

steps.title: Compare sides and record the range
steps.detail: Write the angle or the point at which symptoms begin, and the side-to-side difference. A difference of more than about 10° to 15° is meaningful in the straight leg raise, together with the symptoms. || Sides compare karein aur range likhein

question.en: During a slump test the patient's calf pain eases when you release the neck flexion. What does this suggest?
question.ur: Slump test mein jab aap gardan ka flexion chhor dete hain to patient ki pindli ka dard kam ho jata hai. Yeh kya batata hai?

text.en: It is a hamstring muscle strain

feedback.en: A muscle problem would not change when the neck is moved.
feedback.ur: Muscle ke masle mein gardan hilane se farq nahi parta.

text.en: The nerve is involved, because a distant movement changed the symptoms
text.ur: Nerve shamil hai, kyunke door ki harkat se alamat badli

feedback.en: Yes — structural differentiation shows the symptom comes from the nerve system, not just the local muscle.
feedback.ur: Haan — structural differentiation dikhata hai ke alamat nerve system se aa rahi hai, sirf local muscle se nahi.

text.en: The test is negative and can be ignored
text.ur: Test negative hai aur nazar andaz kiya ja sakta hai

feedback.en: A change with differentiation is a positive finding.
feedback.ur: Differentiation se badlao positive finding hai.

rows.en: One end lengthens while the other shortens, so the nerve glides
rows.ur: Ek sira lamba hota hai jabke doosra chhota, nerve sarakti hai

rows.en: Both ends lengthen together, so the nerve stretches
rows.ur: Dono sire saath lambay hote hain, nerve khinchti hai

rows.en: Irritable, painful nerves and early treatment
rows.ur: Irritable, dardnak nerves aur shuruati ilaaj

rows.en: Settled nerves that tolerate load, later in treatment
rows.ur: Settled nerves jo bojh bardasht karein, ilaaj ke baad ke marhale mein

text.en: **Slide before you stretch.** Start with a slider; only move to a tensioner when the nerve is calm and the patient has no symptoms that linger after treatment.
text.ur: **Stretch se pehle slide.** Slider se shuru karein; tensioner tab istemal karein jab nerve shaant ho aur ilaaj ke baad alamat na rahe.

text.en: **Stretching an irritable nerve into pain.** Pulling hard on a sensitive nerve can make the symptoms worse and last longer. The aim of a slider is a gentle movement with, at most, mild familiar symptoms that settle within a minute or two.
text.ur: **Irritable nerve ko dard tak khenchna.** Sensitive nerve ko zor se khenchne se alamat bigar sakti hain aur der tak rehti hain. Slider ka maqsad halki harkat hai jis mein zyada se zyada halki jaani pehchani alamat ho jo ek do minute mein kam ho jaye.

question.en: Which finding is the best sign that you progressed too far?
question.ur: Kaun si finding sab se acchi nishani hai ke aap bohat aage barh gaye?

text.en: The patient feels the movement is easy
text.ur: Patient ko harkat aasan lagti hai

text.en: A mild familiar tingle that goes in a minute
text.ur: Halki jaani pehchani jhunjhunahat jo ek minute mein chali jaye

feedback.en: This is acceptable in neural mobilisation.
feedback.ur: Neural mobilisation mein yeh qabil-e-qabool hai.

text.en: Symptoms linger or are worse an hour after the treatment
text.ur: Ilaaj ke ek ghante baad bhi alamat rehti hain ya zyada hain

feedback.en: Right — lingering or worse symptoms mean the dose was too high; reduce the range or the tension.
feedback.ur: Theek — lambi ya zyada alamat ka matlab dose bohat zyada tha; range ya tension kam karein.

question.en: What makes a neurodynamic test positive?
question.ur: Neurodynamic test positive kab hota hai?

text.en: It reproduces the patient's own symptoms and changes with structural differentiation
text.ur: Yeh patient ki apni alamat dobara paida karta hai aur structural differentiation se badalta hai

feedback.en: Yes — both parts are needed, otherwise a stretch of the hamstring could be mistaken for a nerve sign.
feedback.ur: Haan — dono hissay zaroori hain, warna hamstring ka stretch nerve sign samjha ja sakta hai.

text.en: The leg cannot be raised past 30°

feedback.en: Range alone does not show a nerve source.
feedback.ur: Sirf range nerve ki wajah nahi dikhati.

text.en: The patient feels a stretch behind the thigh
text.ur: Patient ko thigh ke peechay stretch mehsoos hota hai

feedback.en: A stretch in the hamstring is a normal response.
feedback.ur: Hamstring mein stretch normal response hai.

text.en: **Dose it gently.** A typical start is a slider repeated about 10 times for 2 to 3 sets, with symptoms never worse than mild and settling quickly. Combine it with advice, movement and treatment of the cause, such as a tight tunnel or a stiff neck.
text.ur: **Halka dose dein.** Aam shuruaat slider takriban 10 baar, 2 se 3 sets, jis mein alamat kabhi halki se zyada na hon aur jaldi settle ho jayen. Saath mein advice, harkat aur sabab ka ilaaj, maslan tang tunnel ya akarha hua neck.

question.en: Why does a straight leg raise reproduce back pain without leg symptoms in some people?
question.ur: Kuch logon mein straight leg raise sirf kamar ka dard kyun paida karta hai, taang ki alamat nahi?

answer.en: Because the movement also loads the hamstrings, the sciatic nerve sheath, the lumbar joints and the back muscles. Back-only pain is a non-specific finding. A positive neurodynamic test needs symptoms in the leg that match the patient's complaint and that change with structural differentiation.
answer.ur: Kyunke yeh harkat hamstrings, sciatic nerve sheath, lumbar joints aur kamar ke muscles par bhi bojh daalti hai. Sirf kamar ka dard non-specific finding hai. Positive neurodynamic test mein taang mein woh alamat chahiye jo patient ki shikayat se milti hon aur structural differentiation se badalti hon.

beats.patient: A 38-year-old has leg pain and tingling from the buttock to the calf after lifting a heavy box. Straight leg raise reproduces the tingling at 45° on the right and 70° on the left; releasing the neck flexion in slump reduces it.
beats.assessment: The right nerve is irritable and sensitive: symptoms change with distant movement and the side difference is large.
beats.treatment: Start with sliders for the right side, advise movement and avoid forced stretching. Reassess the response after 24 hours.
beats.reassess: Symptoms settle over three visits and the straight leg raise improves to 65°; sliders progress to gentle tensioners.

text.en: **Refer urgently** for progressive leg weakness, foot drop, loss of bladder or bowel control, saddle numbness, or numbness in both legs: these suggest severe root or cauda equina compression. Do not use tensioners in an acute, severe or worsening radiculopathy.
text.ur: **Fori refer karein** taang ki barhti kamzori, foot drop, peshab ya pakhane par control ki kami, saddle area ka sunn hona, ya dono taangon mein sunn hona: yeh shadeed root ya cauda equina compression ke ishare hain. Acute, shadeed ya barhti hui radiculopathy mein tensioners istemal na karein.

summary.en: Neurodynamic tests load a nerve to see if it is the source; a positive test reproduces the patient's own symptoms and changes with structural differentiation.
summary.ur: Neurodynamic tests nerve par bojh daal kar dekhte hain ke kya sabab yehi hai; positive test patient ki apni alamat dobara paida karta hai aur structural differentiation se badalta hai.

summary.en: Sliders move the nerve with low tension; tensioners stretch it. Start with sliders and progress only when the nerve is calm.
summary.ur: Sliders nerve ko kam tension se hilate hain; tensioners use khinchte hain. Sliders se shuru karein aur tab barhein jab nerve shaant ho.

summary.en: Dose gently and watch the next 24 hours; refer for progressive weakness or loss of bladder, bowel or saddle sensation.
summary.ur: Halka dose dein aur agle 24 ghante dekhein; barhti kamzori ya peshab, pakhane ya saddle sensation ki kami par refer karein.

back.en: A test that moves a limb to load a nerve and reproduce symptoms, such as the straight leg raise or slump test.
back.ur: Aisa test jo limb hila kar nerve par bojh daalta hai aur alamat dobara paida karta hai, maslan straight leg raise ya slump test.

back.en: Changing a movement far from the symptom to see whether the symptom changes, which points to the nerve.
back.ur: Alamat se door ki harkat badal kar dekhna ke alamat badli ya nahi, jo nerve ki taraf ishara karta hai.

front.en: Slider or tensioner for an irritable nerve?
front.ur: Irritable nerve ke liye slider ya tensioner?

back.en: A slider: it glides the nerve with low tension.
back.ur: Slider: yeh nerve ko kam tension se sarkata hai.

front.ur: Kaun si alamat par fori refer karein?

back.en: Progressive weakness, foot drop, bladder or bowel changes, saddle numbness or numbness in both legs.
back.ur: Barhti kamzori, foot drop, peshab ya pakhane ki tabdeeli, saddle sunn hona ya dono taangon mein sunn hona.

note.en: Practise the nerve tests in the Skills Lab.
note.ur: Skills Lab mein nerve tests ki mashq karein.

note.en: When root or cord symptoms mean urgent referral.
note.ur: Root ya cord ki alamat kab urgent referral ka matlab hai.
